action.instructions: Which one action does the appliance take for the user's words? Each option is a whole action on what the appliance itself holds: what is playing, the music, the app, what it knows. Choose page when the words are about something on the page open. Choose none when the words are not a command.

options.media-play: play the media playing, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube": start it, or carry on playing it
options.media-pause: pause the media playing, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube"
options.media-forward: go forward in the media playing, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube" by a length of time, the amount Choice saying how far
options.media-back: go back in the media playing, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube" by a length of time, the amount Choice saying how far
options.media-restart: play the media playing, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube" again from the start
options.media-volume: change the volume of the media playing, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube": up, down or to the number the words carry, the amount Choice saying which and how far
options.media-mute: mute the media playing, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube"
options.media-unmute: unmute the media playing, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube"
options.media-loop: put the media playing, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube" on loop, so it repeats
options.media-unloop: stop looping the media playing, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube"
options.media-rate: change the playback speed of the media playing, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube": faster, slower or to the number the words carry (1 is normal), the amount Choice saying which and how far
options.play: music: find a song or video by the words and play it now, on YouTube or on this site as the words point — never the page's play button, which is a click
options.play_next: music: find a song by the words and play it after the one playing
options.queue: music: find a song by the words and add it to the end of the queue
options.show: music: show the video playing on the screen
options.timer: the app: set a timer for the length the words say
options.timer_off: the app: turn the timer off
options.flag: the app: mark the last thing it did as a failure, for its makers to look at — the words after it, if any, are the hint
options.help: the app: show and say what it can be asked to do
options.stop: stop what the app is doing: the page loading, the voice speaking
options.page: something on the page open, "YE - HIGHS AND LOWS - YouTube": its links, buttons, fields or text
options.none: not a command: a remark, a question to no one, noise

slot.instructions: Which words of the transcript are the thing the command carries verbatim: the address to open, the search terms, the song to play, the text to type, the key to press? Never the command word itself: "play X" carries X. A line with no command word, such as a question, carries itself: its search terms are the line as asked. Choose none when it carries none.

options.none: the command carries no words of its own

amount.instructions: Only when the action skips forward or back in a video or audio, changes its volume or speed, or changes an app number (a setting's amount, the panel's width): how far? For a skip, choose words when the words say how far — a number of seconds, or of minutes; otherwise the share of its length the words mean. For a volume, a speed or an app number, choose to when the words carry the level, else up or down and how far. Ignored for every other action.

options.words: as far as the words say: the number they carry, in seconds, or in minutes when they say minutes
options.moment: a moment: a hundredth of its length
options.little: a little: a twentieth of its length
options.chunk: a chunk: a tenth of its length
options.lot: a lot: a quarter of its length
options.end: all the way: to the end, or back to the start
options.to: the volume, speed or app number to the number the words carry
options.up-little: the volume, speed or app number up a little
options.up-step: the volume, speed or app number up a step
options.up-lot: the volume, speed or app number up a lot
options.up-all: the volume, speed or app number up as far as it goes
options.down-little: the volume, speed or app number down a little
options.down-step: the volume, speed or app number down a step
options.down-lot: the volume, speed or app number down a lot
options.down-all: the volume, speed or app number down as far as it goes

where.instructions: Where do the words point: at something on this page, at something on youtube.com that is not on this page, or somewhere else on the web?

options.page: on this page: one of the numbered refs
options.site: on youtube.com but not on this page: a page, a person, a post, a section of it
options.web: elsewhere: another website, or a search of the whole web
